name: llm_capability_naming_defaults
description: Managed default guidance for LLM capability cluster naming.
lines: For each cluster, output a clean 1-4 word lowercase label for a real transferable professional skill or capability.
Prefer broad transferable capability names over raw task fragments.
Keep labels grounded in the cluster and do not invent new evidence.
Do not output tools unless the cluster is clearly about that tool.
Keep the same order as input.
Return a JSON array of strings only, one per input cluster.
